# Icon fixture attribution

`gr00t_snowflake.png` is a raster crop [1277,196,59,60] of complete Figure 3,
**GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots**, NVIDIA;
Johan Bjorck, Fernando Castañeda et al., arXiv:2503.14734v2 (27 March 2025).
Source and paper-specific CC BY 4.0 evidence: [existing repository attribution](../../../examples/gallery/gr00t_n1/ATTRIBUTION.md)
and [provenance](../../../examples/gallery/gr00t_n1/provenance.json).
The crop is a test fixture; no original PDF vectors or text coordinates were extracted.
